title: A ceramide cream and cleanser for eczema, against a placebo set for 28 days [placebo_set, twenty_eight_days]
teaser: Adults with moderate eczema used a ceramide cream and cleanser, or a look-alike placebo set, for 28 days. [inclusion_moderate, placebo_set, twenty_eight_days] The eczema score showed no clear difference between them. [easi_ns] The ceramide set did keep more water in the skin. [hydration_up]
hook: With a ceramide cream and cleanser, the eczema score fell to 8.25 by day 28. [easi_active_28] With a placebo set, it fell to 7.84. [easi_placebo_28]
populationPanel: Who this was tested in: 100 adults with moderate eczema, from one Sydney skin clinic. [itt_100, inclusion_moderate, recruited] They were aged 18 to 73, and about half were Asian. [age_mean, asian_row] Everyone stopped their usual creams and skin medicines; both groups had a steroid gel to use if needed. [washout, rescue_steroid] A random draw put 50 on each set, and 83 finished. [randomized_blocks, per_group_50, completed_83]

card.question: Does a ceramide cream and cleanser calm eczema better than a placebo set? [easi_ns]
card.headline: After 28 days, the eczema score showed no clear difference between the two sets. [easi_ns]
card.support: Water loss through the skin fell more with the ceramide set. [tewl_lower]

glance.alt: Two rows, one for each set: a line from the score at the start to the score at the end. [easi_active_0, easi_active_28] The two lines nearly match. [easi_ns]

paragraphs: Picture the outer layer of your skin as a brick wall. [-] The cells are the bricks, and a fatty mortar fills the gaps between them. [mortar] Part of that mortar is a family of fats called ceramides. [mortar]

In eczema, the mortar holds less ceramide. [ceramide_low] Water seeps out through the gaps, the skin dries, and irritants get in more easily. [leaky] The water escaping this way is called transepidermal water loss. [leaky]

The tested cream carries two ceramides, cholesterol and a fatty acid in a set ratio. [ratio_311] It also draws water into the skin, seals it in, and smooths the surface. [triple_system] The authors say ordinary moisturizers mostly sit on top, while skin fats like ceramides soak in. [conventional]

On the wall itself, the ceramide set did better than the placebo set. [-] Water loss through the skin fell more, and skin hydration rose more. [tewl_lower, hydration_up] Hydration stayed ahead of the placebo set at every weekly visit. [hydration_better]
The eczema itself is another matter. [-] The redness, swelling, itch and thickening the eczema score counts improved about as much with either set. [easi_scale, easi_ns]

figure.caption: Each line runs from a group's average eczema score at the start to its score at day 28. [easi_active_0, easi_active_28, easi_placebo_0, easi_placebo_28]
figure.alt: Two rows on one scale. [-] Ceramide set: from 14.70 to 8.25. [easi_active_0, easi_active_28] Placebo set: from 14.28 to 7.84. [easi_placebo_0, easi_placebo_28]

paragraphs: The tested routine ran for 28 days. [twenty_eight_days] Once a day, massage the cleanser into wet skin over the whole body, then rinse and pat dry. [cleanser_daily] Apply the cream liberally to the whole body twice a day, morning and night. [cream_twice] One of those goes on straight after the wash. [cream_after_wash]
Both groups stopped their usual moisturizers and had a steroid gel to use if needed. [washout, rescue_steroid] How much gel they used showed no clear difference. [rescue_ns]

audit.effect: Eczema score at day 28: no clear difference between the two sets (p = .7804). [easi_ns] It went from 14.70 to 8.25 with the ceramide set, and from 14.28 to 7.84 with placebo. [easi_active_0, easi_active_28, easi_placebo_0, easi_placebo_28]
audit.weakEnd: The paper reports no confidence interval for the difference in eczema score. [easi_ns] Its ± figures are standard errors, which the read does not turn into a range. [sem] So how large a difference the trial could have missed stays unknown. [easi_ns]
limitations: Run by the cream's maker, which employs six of the authors. [limit_sponsor]
Water loss and hydration were secondary outcomes; the main outcome showed no clear difference. [limit_secondary]
Only 28 days, with no follow-up afterwards. [limit_short, limit_no_followup]
audit.missed: The abstract ends by saying the set improves the signs and symptoms of eczema. [abstract_claim] The trial's own main outcome, the eczema score, showed no clear difference from placebo. [easi_ns] Itch relief was rated better at day 14, but not at day 28 (p = .7147). [itch_d14, itch_d28] The paper counts softness at day 28 as a win, at p = .0573. [softness]
more: Water loss: better than placebo at every visit except day 21 (p = .0660). [tewl_day21]
Over the 28 days, water loss and hydration improved with the ceramide set, and stayed level or worsened with placebo. [trend]
Quality of life improved in both groups, with no clear difference between them. [dlqi_ns] The abstract gives that test as p = .5256, the results as p = .7804. [dlqi_abstract_p, dlqi_ns]
Dry-skin relief was rated better at days 14 and 28. [dry_skin] Redness, pleasantness, ease of use and overall satisfaction showed no clear difference. [sat_ns]
Side effects: 11 people with the ceramide set and 7 with placebo. [ae_groups] Stinging on application: 5 people, all with the ceramide set. [stinging]
No one left because of side effects, and none were serious. [no_serious]
Registered before it began; double-blind, with identical coded packs. [registered, double_blind, identical_packs]

glossary.plain: Fats that make up part of the mortar between the cells of the outer skin.
Water escaping from the body through the outer layer of the skin.
A look-alike cream and cleanser made without the active skin ingredients.

takeaways: After 28 days, the eczema score showed no clear difference between a ceramide cream and cleanser and a placebo set. [easi_ns]
Water loss through the skin fell more with the ceramide set. [tewl_lower]
Run by the cream's maker, for 28 days only. [limit_sponsor, limit_short]
